Name: Zelophehad
Summary: Zelophehad, son of Hepher, died in the wilderness leaving no sons, and his five daughters appealed to Moses for their father's inheritance.
KeyStory: The daughters of Zelophehad stood before Moses, Eleazar, and the whole congregation, and God ruled that daughters inherit when there is no son.
RelatedPeople: Mahlah; Noah, Daughter of Zelophehad; Hoglah; Milcah, Daughter of Zelophehad; Tirzah; Hepher, Son of Gilead; Moses
LifeLesson: Asking God for justice, in the open, is itself an act of faith.
